title.zh: 以太坊确认Glamsterdam日期，但警告“虚假”构建者可能拖慢链上运行
title.en: Ethereum confirms Glamsterdam dates, but warns 'fake' builders could stall the chain

current_state.zh: Ethereum 开发者已确认 Glamsterdam 测试网日期并警告攻击者可能利用免费测试 ETH 和一次性 builder 身份通过扣留交易载荷扰乱 Sepolia 区块拍卖；以太坊基金会进一步宣布该升级将于 2026 年 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网激活，节点运营商需更新客户端，Hoodi 与主网日期未定。
current_state.en: Ethereum developers confirmed Glamsterdam testnet dates and warned attackers could exploit free test ether and disposable builder identities to disrupt Sepolia block auctions by withholding transaction payloads; the Ethereum Foundation further announced the upgrade will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026, requiring node operators to update clients, with Hoodi and mainnet dates undecided.

updates.title_zh: 以太坊基金会将于10月6日在Sepolia测试网上激活Glamsterdam升级
updates.title_en: 以太坊基金会将于10月6日在Sepolia测试网上激活Glamsterdam升级
updates.what_changed_zh: 以太坊基金会宣布 Glamsterdam 升级将于 2026 年 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网激活（epoch 353,024，slot 11,296,768），要求节点运营商更新执行层与共识层客户端；Hoodi 与主网激活时间尚未确定。
updates.what_changed_en: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam upgrade will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026 (epoch 353,024, slot 11,296,768), requiring node operators to update execution and consensus clients; Hoodi and mainnet activation dates remain undecided.
updates.current_state_zh: Ethereum 开发者已确认 Glamsterdam 测试网日期并警告攻击者可能利用免费测试 ETH 和一次性 builder 身份通过扣留交易载荷扰乱 Sepolia 区块拍卖；以太坊基金会进一步宣布该升级将于 2026 年 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网激活，节点运营商需更新客户端，Hoodi 与主网日期未定。
updates.current_state_en: Ethereum developers confirmed Glamsterdam testnet dates and warned attackers could exploit free test ether and disposable builder identities to disrupt Sepolia block auctions by withholding transaction payloads; the Ethereum Foundation further announced the upgrade will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026, requiring node operators to update clients, with Hoodi and mainnet dates undecided.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam upgrade — combining execution-layer Amsterdam and consensus-layer Gloas, with ePBS, block-level access lists and gas-pricing changes — will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026, requiring node operators to update clients while Hoodi and mainnet dates remain undecided.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam upgrade — combining execution-layer Amsterdam and consensus-layer Gloas, with ePBS, block-level access lists and gas-pricing changes — will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026, requiring node operators to update clients while Hoodi and mainnet dates remain undecided.
